name: water-crystal-skill-vfx
description: Build the effects of a water and crystal skill as one visual language in Three.js. Water that reads as clear water, never a teal fill or a textured ball. A ray-marched water orb whose surface swells, rings and deforms in place: it refracts the frame behind it with an inverted horizon, has a silver rim and sharp highlights, and shows a faint caustic web on its far wall.
